name: 记账
summary: 多账户复式记账与预算

localizedSummaries.en: Multi-account ledger with budgets, projects and shared-expense settlement

actions.name: record
actions.summary: Record, edit or delete one ledger entry: an expense, an income, or a transfer between two accounts. Only `amount` is required for a new expense — category, account and date all have sensible defaults, so do NOT stop and ask the user for them. Pass a stable `request_id` (a UUID) on every add so a retry can never double-post. Use the ledger account tool to create accounts; this tool never creates one from scratch.

Never guess delete."},"type":{"type":"string","enum":["expense","income","transfer"],"description":"Defaults to expense."},"amount":{"type":"number","description":"Required for add and always positive, in major units (12.50). Direction comes from `type`, never from a sign."},"currency":{"type":"string","description":"ISO code or a colloquial name (ringgit, 马币). If given without an account, routes to a same-currency account. A currency with no configured rate is refused outright."},"category":{"type":"string","description":"Category name, or a two-level path 'Parent/Child'. Ignored for transfers."},"account":{"type":"string","description":"Which account the money came from. Defaults to the default account. actions.name: query
actions.summary: List individual ledger entries matching filters. Returns the count, the expense total in the base currency, and one line per entry ending in [id: …] so it can be updated or deleted afterwards. An unresolvable category/account/project name comes back as a candidate list rather than being silently ignored.

actions.name: stats
actions.summary: Aggregate spending or income into buckets by category, subcategory, day, month, account, tag or project. Shares one implementation with the in-app Reports screen, so quoted numbers always match what the user sees. Amounts are in the base currency at the exchange rate frozen when each entry was posted. Transfers and balance adjustments are excluded.

actions.name: budget
actions.summary: Read budget status or set a monthly limit. Status shares one implementation with the in-app Budget screen and reports the total limit, spent, remaining, days left and the daily allowance, plus each category line (flagged when over, annotated when it carries a rollover). Setting a limit of 0 deletes that budget.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["status","set"],"description":"Defaults to status."},"category":{"type":"string","description":"Omit for the overall monthly budget."},"limit":{"type":"number","description":"Major units. 0 removes the budget."},"month":{"type":"string","description":"YYYY-MM (also accepts YYYYMM or YYYY/MM). Defaults to the current month."},"carryover":{"type":"boolean","description":"Roll this month's unspent amount into next month. Overspending never carries a negative."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: account
actions.summary: List accounts with balances and net worth, create an account, set an account's balance (a Beancount-style balance assertion that posts a visible calibration entry), archive one, or rename one. This is the ONLY way to create an account — the record tool never creates one. For credit accounts a positive initial_balance is stored as the amount owed.

actions.name: category
actions.summary: List, create, rename or archive spending and income categories. Categories are two levels deep at most. When the user wants a category that does not exist yet, create it rather than forcing the entry into an existing one. Archiving only removes it from pickers; existing entries keep it.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["list","create","rename","archive"],"description":"Defaults to list."},"name":{"type":"string"},"new_name":{"type":"string"},"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["expense","income"],"description":"Defaults to expense."},"parent":{"type":"string","description":"Attach under a top-level category to make it a subcategory."},"archived":{"type":"boolean"}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: currency
actions.summary: Manage currencies and exchange rates: list them, add one, set a rate manually, change the base currency all statistics are priced in, or refresh rates online. A currency with no configured rate is EXCLUDED from converted totals rather than being faked at 1:1, so add the rate before recording in it. Setting a rate marks it manual and online refreshes will not overwrite it.
actions.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["list","add","set_rate","set_preferred","refresh"],"description":"Defaults to list."},"code":{"type":"string","description":"ISO code or a colloquial name; normalised to a 3-letter code."},"rate":{"type":"number","description":"How many units of the BASE currency one unit of `code` is worth."}},"additionalProperties":false}

actions.name: project
actions.summary: Projects group a trip or event's spending, and carry shared-expense settlement. Actions: list, create, activate (pass 'none' to clear), update, archive, summary, members, add_member, remove_member, settle (member balances plus the fewest transfers that zero them out), record_settlement. Adding the first member auto-creates a 'Me' member. A settlement involving the user also posts a matching ledger entry.

actions.name: openAI
actions.summary: Open the in-app AI analysis panel.

actions.name: exportCSV
actions.summary: Export every ledger entry as a CSV file and hand it to the share sheet.

actions.name: importCSV
actions.summary: Pick a ledger CSV file and open the import preview. Selecting a file never writes anything on its own.

actions.name: openRecentlyDeleted
actions.summary: Open the recently deleted entries screen, where entries can be restored or permanently removed.
